card.name: Route words after inject or administer
card.fires_on: The word right after an instruction verb like inject or administer (often "directly", or a drug or diluent name), just before the body site or route is given.

modes.label: Directly after inject
modes.description: The word "directly" follows inject or injected, before "into" a vein or solution.
modes.example: Inject 25% Albumin Human USP (IV Solution Stabilizer)<< directly>> into the 0.9% Sodium

modes.label: Drug name as object of inject
modes.description: The end of a drug or diluent name that is the object of inject, before the route.
modes.example: Inject LEQV<<IO>> subcutaneously into the abdomen, upper

modes.label: Administer by route
modes.description: The word "by" or "directly" after administer, before the route or method.
modes.example: Administer ProAir Digihaler<< by>> oral inhalation only.

card.writes: It pushes toward Chinese words for collision, striking and direction (e.g. 撞, 垂直, 倾斜), which fits the sense of directing a physical motion.
card.plain: It fires on the word after "inject" or "administer" where the text is about to say how or where the drug goes in.
